summary: Inwentaryzacja sprzetu feature fully validated end-to-end. 10/10 backend pytest cases pass (start for all 3 categories, invalid 400, list, finish, finish-unknown 404, auto-close previous on new start for same category, active-for-me with attached equipment, foreman confirm + active-for-me empty after). Frontend Playwright verified: admin sees 'Inwentaryzacja' button (data-testid=start-inventory-btn) on Elektronarzedzia tab, button correctly disabled while active, 'Aktywna inwentaryzacja' card (data-testid=active-inventory-card) renders with finish-inventory-{id} button. Foreman blocking modal (data-testid=inventory-check-modal) appears on /worker/dashboard with per-equipment checkboxes (inventory-checkbox-{eq_id}), 'Potwierdzam wszystko' button (inventory-confirm-btn) disabled until ALL 4 checkboxes ticked - verified disabled=true before, disabled=false after. Progress text 'Zaznaczono: 4 / 4' rendered. After confirm: toast 'Inwentaryzacja potwierdzona' shown, modal disappears, foreman dashboard usable.

issues: Pre-existing Google Maps ApiProjectMapError on dashboard (unrelated to inventory feature)

critical_code_review_comments: equipment.py start_inventory: notification creation per foreman (line 906-920) silently swallows all exceptions with bare except - if notifications collection fails consistently nobody will know. Consider logging.

equipment.py confirm_inventory line 1009: when payload is None or confirmed_equipment_ids is None, sets confirmed_ids=[]. The endpoint silently allows confirmation with empty audit list; UI enforces 'all checked' but a malicious foreman can POST with empty list and bypass - audit-only impact since required_foremen still tracks who confirmed.

equipment.py active-for-me line 970-973: ignores category filter when fetching foreman's assignments; loads ALL their assignments then filters by category via equipment join. For foremen with many assignments this is fine but a $lookup pipeline would be cleaner.

InventoryCheckModal.js line 31: catch (e) {} swallows fetch errors silently - if /equipment/inventory/active-for-me 500s the modal just stays loading=false and renders nothing, foreman has no feedback. Consider toast on error.

InventoryCheckModal.js: shows only first active check at a time (line 83 'Show first active check (sequential)') - if foreman has 3 active inventories he must confirm one, the next one appears after the page refetch. Works but UX-wise a counter is shown ('Pozostalo do wykonania: N').

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin button + card + foreman modal + checkbox flow + confirm all verified)
